name: Fincal
description: Personal finance per space: accounts (bank/cash/UPI/credit card), expenses, budgets, envelopes, goals, investments (stocks, mutual funds, metals, FDs, RDs, …), net-worth tracker, retirement planner, analytics and calculators. Workspace-level access.

endpoints.name: listAccounts
endpoints.description: Accounts of a space with live balance. Credit cards add due / available / utilizationPct (balance is negative when money is owed).

endpoints.name: createAccount
endpoints.description: Creates account in a space.

endpoints.name: updateAccount
endpoints.description: Updates account.

endpoints.name: deleteAccount
endpoints.description: Deletes account. Fails with 409 if still referenced.

endpoints.name: listCategories
endpoints.description: Income/expense categories of a space (default set is seeded on first use).

endpoints.name: createCategory
endpoints.description: Creates categorie in a space.

endpoints.name: updateCategory
endpoints.description: Updates categorie.

endpoints.name: deleteCategory
endpoints.description: Deletes categorie. Fails with 409 if still referenced.

endpoints.name: listTransactions
endpoints.description: Transactions of a space, newest first, with filters (date range, account, category, envelope, kind, method, tag, text). Returns totals for the filtered set.

endpoints.name: createTransaction
endpoints.description: Records an expense, income or transfer. Transfers move money between two accounts (a credit-card payment is a transfer from a bank account to the card).

endpoints.name: updateTransaction
endpoints.description: Edits a transaction (any field).

endpoints.name: deleteTransaction
endpoints.description: Deletes a transaction.

endpoints.name: listPayees
endpoints.description: Distinct payees and tags used in a space (for autocomplete).

endpoints.name: listBudgets
endpoints.description: Monthly budgets with spending for a month (default current). Also returns spending in categories that have no budget.

endpoints.name: setBudget
endpoints.description: Creates or updates the monthly budget for an expense category.

endpoints.name: deleteBudget
endpoints.description: Removes a category budget.

endpoints.name: listEnvelopes
endpoints.description: Envelopes with funded / spent / balance. `unallocated` = spendable account money (bank, cash, UPI, wallet) not yet assigned to an envelope.

endpoints.name: createEnvelope
endpoints.description: Creates envelope in a space.

endpoints.name: updateEnvelope
endpoints.description: Updates envelope.

endpoints.name: deleteEnvelope
endpoints.description: Deletes envelope. Fails with 409 if still referenced.

endpoints.name: allocateEnvelope
endpoints.description: Funds an envelope (positive amount) or releases money from it (negative).

endpoints.name: transferBetweenEnvelopes
endpoints.description: Moves allocated money from one envelope to another.

endpoints.name: fillEnvelopes
endpoints.description: Adds each envelope's monthly fill amount (the monthly top-up ritual).

endpoints.name: envelopeHistory
endpoints.description: Allocations and tagged expenses of one envelope, newest first.

endpoints.name: deleteEnvelopeAllocation
endpoints.description: Removes one allocation entry.

endpoints.name: listGoals
endpoints.description: Savings goals with saved amount, progress and the monthly saving needed to hit the target date.

endpoints.name: createGoal
endpoints.description: Creates goal in a space.

endpoints.name: updateGoal
endpoints.description: Updates goal.

endpoints.name: deleteGoal
endpoints.description: Deletes goal. Fails with 409 if still referenced.

endpoints.name: addGoalContribution
endpoints.description: Adds money to a goal (negative amount withdraws).

endpoints.name: listGoalContributions
endpoints.description: Contribution history of a goal.

endpoints.name: deleteGoalContribution
endpoints.description: Removes one contribution.

endpoints.name: listHoldings
endpoints.description: Investments with computed invested / value / gain. FDs and RDs are valued from their terms (principal, rate, compounding, dates) and show maturity value; stocks/funds/metals use quantity × current price; PPF/EPF/NPS/real-estate use the manual current value.

endpoints.name: createHolding
endpoints.description: Creates holding in a space.

endpoints.name: updateHolding
endpoints.description: Updates holding.

endpoints.name: deleteHolding
endpoints.description: Deletes holding. Fails with 409 if still referenced.

endpoints.name: updateHoldingPrices
endpoints.description: Bulk-updates current prices / NAVs (e.g. after copying quotes). Items: [{id, price}].

endpoints.name: tradeHolding
endpoints.description: Records a buy (weighted-average cost updates) or sell on a quantity-based holding (stock, fund, metal, crypto…). Also sets the current price to the trade price.

endpoints.name: listHoldingTrades
endpoints.description: Buy/sell history of a holding.

endpoints.name: listLiabilities
endpoints.description: Lists liabilities (loans) of a space.

endpoints.name: createLiability
endpoints.description: Creates liabilities (loans) in a space.

endpoints.name: updateLiability
endpoints.description: Updates liabilities (loans).

endpoints.name: deleteLiability
endpoints.description: Deletes liabilities (loans). Fails with 409 if still referenced.

endpoints.name: getSettings
endpoints.description: Space settings: currency and net-worth target.

endpoints.name: updateSettings
endpoints.description: Updates the space's currency (ISO code) and/or net-worth target (null clears).

endpoints.name: getNetWorth
endpoints.description: Net worth now (assets − liabilities, with breakdown), saved daily snapshots (history), 12-month net-cash trend rebuilt from transactions, and progress toward the target.

endpoints.name: saveNetWorthSnapshot
endpoints.description: Stores today's net-worth snapshot (idempotent; one per day).

endpoints.name: getRetirement
endpoints.description: Saved retirement plan (or defaults), retirement corpus built from flagged holdings (+PPF/EPF/NPS) and the projection: required corpus, projected corpus, shortfall, saving needed, year-by-year series.

endpoints.name: saveRetirement
endpoints.description: Saves the retirement plan assumptions (partial update).

endpoints.name: projectRetirement
endpoints.description: What-if projection with overridden assumptions; nothing is saved.

endpoints.name: getOverview
endpoints.description: Dashboard for a month (default current): income/expense/net, month-end spending projection, budget status, net worth, accounts, credit-card dues, top categories, recent transactions.

endpoints.name: getAnalytics
endpoints.description: Spending analytics over a range (default last 12 months): monthly income/expense/savings, category breakdown and trend, payment-method and account split, top payees, weekday pattern, recurring payees, and a 3-month forecast from the completed-month trend.
